outcome: blood loss in the first 24 hours after surgery
cohort: 84 women with placenta accreta and placenta increta (42 in the barbed suture group and 42 in the control group).
finding: The use of barbed suture for uterine repair in women with placenta accreta and placenta increta significantly reduced blood loss both during cesarean section and in the first 24 hours after surgery compared to conventional suture.
